_note: How each role scores positions and actions for the tactics AI (DESIGN.md section 9). Our own data. Ranges in spaces; weights are multipliers on the score parts.

artillery.description: Stays far back in cover and shoots from long range.

controller.description: Locks on, scans and disrupts from mid range.

defender.description: Stays between the enemy and its allies.

support.description: Keeps near allies, marks targets for them, avoids the front line.

defensive.description: Take cover, shoot only from safety.

support.description: Stay with the squad and mark targets.

follow.description: Stay close to the unit you're following.
